verdict.line: You lose to her level 1-5 all-in windows near tentacle terrain, but you win from level 6 onward once Needlework and your item spikes come online, backing the 55.7% win rate over 460 games.

brief.thesis: Illaoi's early kit is built around forced skirmishes near terrain, where her passive tentacles and W (Harsh Lesson) leap punish you before you have E (Skip 'n Slash) online to kite; Gwen's %-health passive damage and ranged poke only start outscaling that threat once R (Needlework) and a first item are up, which is exactly where the data's solo-kill and lane-advantage numbers flip.

theirWindow.what: She leaps in with W (Harsh Lesson) while nearby tentacles also swing at you, and if E (Test of Spirit, cooldown 16/15/14/13/12s) is also up she can start a vessel snowball. Disengage or break the tether by ducking into W (Hallowed Mist) before it resolves.

yourWindow.when: When Test of Spirit and ultimate are down
yourWindow.what: Throw Q (Snip Snip!) stacks and E-dash autos freely since she has no way to punish the poke, chipping her health bar through your passive's percent-health magic damage.

start.item: Doran's Ring + Health Potion + Health Potion
start.why: The extra potion cushions the chip damage from her tentacles and Harsh Lesson leaps while you ramp toward level 6; this start is run in 91.3% of games at 53.9% win rate for a reason.

boots.why: The magic penetration pushes Snip Snip! and Needlework damage through her rising HP and armor as she stacks tank items to survive your poke.

core.why: Establishes your scaling AP core before her tentacle sustain out-heals your early trades.
Amplifies burst on her low-current-health windows, which is where your passive's percent-health damage hits hardest.
Caps your AP so a single Needlework and E-dash combo threatens to delete her outside of her all-in range; this exact path runs a 69.7% win rate over 76 games.

situational.when: the game goes long and you need omnivamp to out-sustain her tentacle-fueled healing in extended fights
you want more attack speed to stack E's on-hit magic damage window faster
her tentacle procs keep healing her back up in skirmishes and you need grievous wounds to shut it off
her tentacle and auto-attack burst is overwhelming you before level 6

runes.keystoneWhy: Converts prolonged trades into healing, letting you match her tentacle-sustained skirmishes instead of losing the war of attrition near terrain.

summoners.why: Ignite punishes her all-in attempts during your weak levels 1-5 window and secures picks once you flip the lane; Flash lets you slip out of Harsh Lesson or Leap of Faith engages when W (Hallowed Mist) isn't enough.

playing.title: Play safe past level 2
playing.detail: Hold the wave near your tower until you have E (Skip 'n Slash) available; without a dash charge you have no way to escape her Harsh Lesson leap plus nearby tentacle procs.

playing.title: Dodge Test of Spirit
playing.detail: Once she hits level 3, step behind minions or activate W (Hallowed Mist) before her E resolves, since a completed rip echoes damage back to you and can start a vessel snowball.

playing.title: Wall off her engage with W
playing.detail: Hallowed Mist means only enemies who enter it can target you, so drop it right as she commits to Harsh Lesson or her ultimate; if she doesn't follow in, you traded nothing.

playing.title: Snip Snip when her cooldowns are down
playing.detail: With Test of Spirit and Leap of Faith (120/95/70/70/70s) both on cooldown, she has no way to punish poke, so land Q stacks freely.

playing.title: Trade with E, not extended fights
playing.detail: Dash in with Skip 'n Slash, land one on-hit auto for the bonus attack speed and magic damage, then disengage; a landed hit partially refunds the cooldown so you can re-engage before she out-sustains you.

playing.title: Never fight her near terrain
playing.detail: Her tentacles spawn on nearby impassible terrain and swing at anyone in range, so pull skirmishes to open lane instead of tower or wall pockets that add free damage and healing for her.

playing.title: Wait for Shadowflame before forcing
playing.detail: Your passive scales off target health, so once Dusk and Dawn into Shadowflame completes you start deleting her health bar with poke alone; don't force fights before that spike given her early solo-kill advantage.

brief.patchCaveat: The build order, win rates, and pick rates above come from measured OP.GG games on the current patch; the tactical reasoning about ability timing, tentacle terrain, and trade windows is my own read of the kit, not part of the raw data.
